label: Reaper assembly along an endless populated past
definition: ReaperAssembly h Concrete w holds when, for every history v accessible from w and every strictly descending sequence of moments c 0 > c 1 > ... of v such that a contingent concrete individual is present at c 0, there are a Nat-indexed signal assignment and issuance predicate satisfying the four local station rules of IndexedSignalReaper: index admissibility, positive trigger, emission and forwarding. In ordinary language: a non-well-founded past below a populated moment would leave room for a Grim Reaper system of stations.
note: Analyst bridge in the style of the Grim Reaper arguments for a finite past; attribution deferred, no claim is made about any author's principle. The consequent is a closed proposition about Nat functions: it does not mention the sequence, the history or its moments, so 'station n at moment c n' is only a reading, not encoded. The verified IndexedSignalReaper.impossible refutes the consequent, so the bridge is equivalent to the absence of such descents, a reformulation of PopulatedPastsFounded. Its result is recorded as a near-transcription and is not an independent support route. Superseded by the genuine patchwork premises of TruthCore.Causality.GrimReaperPatchwork (local Reaper pieces and Reaper patchwork), which place stations at the moments of the descent in worlds of the history. Applicability OPEN.
